caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical ceramic mug with a rounded handle on its right side. The mug is primarily beige in color, with decorative elements in brown and blue-green hues. Along the exterior surface, there are patterns including stylized flowers resembling sunflowers with radiating lines, leafy vine motifs, and a human figure facing left, adorned with detailed linear patterns on its garment. The mug is marked with the inscription "1809" near the bottom, as well as the letters "P B" beside one of the floral decorations. The rim of the mug is edged in a reddish-brown color, and there are chips and worn areas visible along the edge. A repeated pattern of rounded, brown-tipped shapes encircles the lower portion of the mug above the base. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Pa. German Hildebrandt Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
